messages:
anya: Heads-up — we need to revisit the holiday backfill plan. forecasts show a 38% bump in peak GPU-hours for Nov-Dec vs baseline. thinking about mixing H200 reservations with some L40S for embedding-heavy traffic. does that math work with the lead times?

mike: Agree we should mix. Leadtime for H200 slots from our vendor is 14-18 weeks if we want guaranteed racks. H100 is 8-12. L40S available spot/reserved 4-6 wks. Cost delta: roughly +55% for H200 vs H100 on monthly reserved.

anya: Cool. Quick calc I ran: 
```
Projected peak demand = 1.38 * baseline
Baseline = 1.2M GPU-hours/month
Peak = ~1.66M GPU-hours/month
If we reserve 60% H200 and 40% L40S for burst:
H200 hours = 1.0M, L40S hours = 660k
```
Not final, just starting point.

sophie: Region note — eu-west1 capacity is tight for H200 right now. Vendor ETA there slipped 6 weeks last update. If EU needs H200, we should either prebook or plan cross-region failover to us-west2.

raj: Network constraint: cross-region failover will increase inter-region egress by ~150TB/month at projected traffic — ~ $12k/mo extra. Also, placing KV cache primaries across regions hurts cold-start latency for chat sessions.

kai: Alternative: buy fewer H200 reserved slots and use provider spot burst for short peaks. Spot H200 availability is decent in us-west but unpredictable. Could combine autoscale policy: reserved baseline + spot burst + L40S for embedding queues.

anya: That seems sensible. We need concrete numbers to present to finance. Can we get: 1) reserve-only plan cost (H200 heavy), 2) hybrid reserved+spot plan, 3) L40S-heavy plan (cheaper but higher per-token latency). Also include lead times per region.

mike: I can assemble numbers. Ask finance: target max monthly spend for Q4? that drives how big reserved commit we can justify.

infra-bot: cluster-health:cluster-pool-7 -> 3 nodes reporting degraded NVLink perf; ticket #INC-4821 created. ETA investigation 2h.

raj: That degraded NVLink on pool-7 is in us-west2 H200 cluster, FYI — could reduce sustained throughput if we move workloads. Recommend marking pool-7 as ‘no-new-alloc’ until fixed.

anya: Good catch. mark it in the plan: if pool-7 impacted, our fallback shifts more load to other H200 pools and L40S. That increases cost by ~6-8% in worst case.

sophie: For procurement cadence: if we want guaranteed racks in eu-west1 by Nov 15, order needs to be placed by Aug 20 (vendor confirmation). If we miss, leadtime pushes H200 into Jan.

kai: Ops action: I’ll draft three config templates for the rollout (reserved-heavy, hybrid, L40S-heavy) with K8s taints/tolerations and autoscaler policies. will include metrics we should watch: token throughput, p95 latency, inter-region egress, spot eviction rate.

mike: I’ll run cost sims based on current pricing and include sensitivity (±20% demand). targeting a short deck by EOD Thursday.

anya: Thanks. Action list: @mike cost sims + sensitivity, @kai rollout templates, @sophie confirm eu-west vendor ETA in writing, @raj quantify egress delta and NVLink risk, infra-bot pls attach INC-4821 once triaged. We’ll reconvene Fri 09:30 PT. :calendar: 

infra-bot: noted -> meeting created: #infra-holiday-hardware 2023-12-01 09:30 PT, invites sent to participants.
